name: Squarespace
one_liner: Squarespace is a website/ecommerce platform whose Commerce APIs let developers manage orders, inventory, products and transactions via REST endpoints authenticated with either a site-generated API key or an OAuth app.

notes: Two auth paths documented on the same page: (1) an API key generated in-account under Settings > Advanced > Developer API Keys, which the docs say requires the Commerce Advanced plan; (2) an OAuth client, which requires submitting an app registration (name, icon, redirect URIs, ToS/privacy links) that Squarespace manually reviews before issuing client_id/secret — i.e. not instantly self-serve. So access is gated both by a paid Commerce plan (for API keys) and by manual review (for OAuth apps); picked paid_plan as the primary blocker since it's the more direct/common path, but app_review is a secondary real constraint for the OAuth route. No official or community MCP server found (registry and GitHub search both empty). api_breadth marked "small" based on general knowledge of the Commerce API surface (orders, inventory, products, transactions, profiles, webhooks) — not independently verified by counting endpoints in this pass; treat with lower confidence.
